description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientSearchCriteria class in the OpenMRS project, testing various search parameter handling and mode determination functionalities.

classes.name: PatientSearchCriteriaTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the PatientSearchCriteria functionality within the OpenMRS core project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup by creating instances of PatientSearchCriteria and GlobalPropertiesTestHelper before each test.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldProcessSimpleSpaceAsSeparator
methods.description: Tests that getQueryParts correctly splits a string separated by spaces into individual query parts.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldProcessCommaAsSeparator
methods.description: Tests that getQueryParts correctly splits a comma-separated string into individual query parts.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldProcessMixedSeparators
methods.description: Tests handling of a string with mixed separators (commas and spaces) in getQueryParts.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldNotReturnEmptyNameParts
methods.description: Ensures getQueryParts does not return empty strings for extra spaces in input.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldRejectNullAsName
methods.description: Verifies that getQueryParts throws IllegalArgumentException when input is null.

methods.name: isShortName_shouldRecogniseShortName
methods.description: Checks that isShortName returns true for very short (single character) names.

methods.name: isShortName_shouldRecogniseLongName
methods.description: Checks that isShortName returns false for longer names.

methods.name: getMatchMode_shouldReturnStartAsDefaultMatchMode
methods.description: Verifies default match mode is START when no global property is set.

methods.name: getMatchMode_shouldReturnStartAsConfiguredMatchMode
methods.description: Checks that getMatchMode returns START when configured via global property.

methods.name: getMatchMode_shouldReturnAnywhereAsConfiguredMatchMode
methods.description: Checks that getMatchMode returns ANYWHERE when configured via global property.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByName
methods.description: Tests that various name inputs lead to search mode PATIENT_SEARCH_BY_NAME.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByIdentifier
methods.description: Tests identification of search mode PATIENT_SEARCH_BY_IDENTIFIER based on identifier input.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByIdentifierTypeList
methods.description: Checks detection of identifier search mode with provided list.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByNameOrIdentifier
methods.description: Checks detection of PATIENT_SEARCH_BY_NAME_OR_IDENTIFIER under various input conditions.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByNameAndIdentifier
methods.description: Verifies correct mode when both name and identifier are provided.

methods.name: copySearchParameter_shouldReturnSourceValueWhenTargetIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that copySearchParameter returns source when target is blank or null.

methods.name: copySearchParameter_shouldReturnTargetValueWhenTargetIsNonblank
methods.description: Tests that copySearchParameter returns target when target is non-blank.
